- [rb-0302] Reuse existing money helpers and ZERO constant: When implementing a new money function, import and use to_money, round_money, and ZERO from ledgerly.money rather than constructing Decimals ad hoc.

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(status="captured", amt="100.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

p=mk(); refund(p,"40",T0); refund(p,Decimal("60.00"),T0)
print("full:", p.refunded_amount, p.status)
assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.status=="refunded"

for args,code in [((mk(),"10",T0),"invalid_state"),((mk(),"0",T0),"non_positive_amount"),((mk(),"-5",T0),"non_positive_amount"),((mk(),"abc",T0),"invalid_amount")]:
    try: refund(*args)
    except BillingError as e: print("err:",e.code); assert e.code==code

p=mk(); refund(p,"60",T0)
try: refund(p,"50",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over:",e.code); assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
print("remaining:",p.refunded_amount,p.status)
EOF
